The mulƟplicity of laws, regulaƟons, and local statutes across the country makes adherence to each a challenge for any Company today. We carry the risk of non- compliance in the geographies where we operate, due to constant changes in laws and regulaƟons.

We have a dedicated in- house compliance team that manages compliance. We obtain a compliance cerƟﬁcate from the PracƟsing Company Secretary with respect to the compliance of all applicable Laws and RegulaƟons.
NegaƟve implicaƟons: Non-compliance would lead to Regulatory acƟon by way of ﬁnes/penalƟes/punishment and also would damage the goodwill of the Company.

Risk: Improper disposal of waste will lead to non-compliance with laws and result in GHG emissions. Opportunity: Increasing demand for raw materials for industrial producƟon and dwindling of non-renewable resources day-by-day forced us to see alternate opƟons for these non-renewable resources. Therefore, eﬀorts will be made for controlling polluƟon arising out of the disposal of wastes by converƟng these unwanted wastes into uƟlizable raw materials for various beneﬁcial uses.

All wastes including hazardous wastes, are disposed as per the regulaƟons to authorized state polluƟon control board partners for recycling/destrucƟon. All other solid wastes (Dry/wet) are disposed to the authorized vendor for recycling/reuse.

NegaƟve implicaƟons: Improper waste disposal is a contributor to excess gases entering the atmosphere. The breakdown of the waste releases gases like methane, which is a major factor in global climate change and also would result in negaƟve regulatory acƟon. PosiƟve ImplicaƟon: Some of the waste such as Fly Ash is being planned to be uƟlized for the producƟon of bricks, cement, and other building materials.
